description: Header file defining structures, classes, and functions for XNNPACK integration within PyTorch's ATen library, including context structures for linear and convolution operations, layout definitions, and availability checks.

classes.name: Deleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for xnn_operator_t to ensure proper resource cleanup.

classes.name: ContextLinear
classes.description: Holds context information for linear (fully connected) layers in XNNPACK.

classes.name: ContextConv2D
classes.description: Holds context information for 2D convolution layers, including parameters like weight size, padding, stride, dilation, transposition, and groups.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Defines layout constants for activation maps, filters, and parameters used in XNNPACK operations.

classes.name: Activation4D
classes.description: Constants for 4D activation map tensor indices.

classes.name: ActivationND
classes.description: Functions to compute batch and channel sizes for ND activation maps.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Constants for parameter tensor indices such as height and width.

methods.name: ContextLinear()
methods.description: Constructor for ContextLinear, initializes with an operator and output channels.

methods.name: ContextConv2D()
methods.description: Constructor for ContextConv2D, initializes with convolution parameters.

methods.name: batch()
methods.description: Calculates the batch size from a tensor shape array.

methods.name: channel()
methods.description: Retrieves the channel size from a tensor shape array.
